paper_reference.caveat: 0.9371 is CKSNP-GNN's own reported 5-fold CV mean (Table 1). No split file is bundled; this run uses a single random 90/10 edge split with 1:1 uniform negatives as an approximation. Data source is a shared institutional mirror whose bundled code is a different model ("GAEMDA") -- notably, GAEMDA is itself one of CKSNP-GNN's own comparison baselines in Table 1 (93.56%), which corroborates (does not just excuse) reusing this mirror's data: both papers evidently drew from the same shared benchmark. Data trusted via exact positive-count match (16,427); code in the mirror is not used or claimed to be CKSNP-GNN's own.
